title: Microsoft Fabric: OneLake, lakehouse and warehouse in one place

videos.script: Lesson 16 sized a pool. In Fabric you size one thing, and everything else draws from it. {{capacity}} That thing is a capacity. Spark, the warehouse, pipelines and Power BI all spend its capacity units. A heavy job does not fail at once. Its cost is spread over a day, and throttling starts only when the future is spent. {{throttle}} Underneath every workspace is one lake for the whole company. OneLake. {{onelake}} A shortcut puts a folder from another account, or another cloud, inside it. Nothing is copied. {{shortcut}} A lakehouse and a warehouse look like two products. They store the same Delta tables, and differ in who writes them. {{tables}} Fabric has no emulator, so most of this lesson comes from Microsoft's documentation. One part does run. You will write a Delta table into a container on your laptop, and open its log. {{delta}} Then Power BI reads that same format with no copy at all. That is Direct Lake, and the file layout decides whether it stays fast. {{direct}}
